text: {Name} ran a checkpoint near {Place} and owed a smuggler money after gambling losses. In exchange for more time to repay the debt, the officer let the smuggler's wagons pass without inspection.
self_review: A checkpoint officer owed a smuggler gambling debts and allowed unchecked wagons through in exchange for delayed repayment.
source_pattern: Plausible invention; the supplied research does not document gambling debts or this arrangement.
fictional_changes: The gambling, smuggler, debt, and checkpoint favor are entirely fictional.
